paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: TP-YOLOv8 trains from scratch, SGD lr0=.01 momentum=.937, batch16, 300epochs/patience50 on A40 48GB. This B0 keeps pretrained yolov8n, SGD/lr/momentum as cited comparison, batch8 with 2 loader workers/60epochs/patience18 on RTX3050Ti 4GB; dataset is ACCIDENT author impact boxes plus train-only weak early negatives, custom source-group split. It does not reproduce TP-YOLOv8 or ACCIDENT metrics.
limitations: Only author impact bbox is positive; train early negatives are weak derived labels; val/test negatives are few prior whole-frame-reviewed samples; new positive geometry not fully manually reviewed; no event, long-video, camera-held-out or official ACCIDENT IID benchmark metric
hardware_decision: Prior batch16 used 3.86 GiB VRAM, completed epoch 1 but checkpoint serialization failed before a file was written; cause unconfirmed because library retries hid the initial RuntimeError. Reduce batch to 8 for GPU memory headroom and log original buffer serialization exception.
